sources.title: google/muril-base-cased · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MuRIL is a BERT model pre-trained on 17 Indian languages and their transliterated counterparts. We have released the pre-trained model (with the MLM layer intact, enabling masked word predictions) in this repository.

sources.title: ab-ai/PII-Model-Phi3-Mini · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains a fine-tuned version of the Phi3 Mini model for detecting personally identifiable information (PII). The model has been specifically trained to recognize various PII entities in text, making it a powerful tool for tasks such as data redaction, privacy protection, and compliance with data protection regulations.
